title: Sector A branch-aware synthesis and termination package
statement: The frozen Sector-A records support two reproducible, explicitly separated chains on the fixed spectral three-torus: the canonical full-production variational functional feeds the conditional full PDE well-posedness theorem and its positive-time exact-Galerkin discretization-to-continuum theorem; independently, the positive-mass real-scalar spectral branch has order-by-order perturbative cutoff removal and a finite-volume non-perturbative constructive Gibbs measure. scope: T4 REFEREE-CANDIDATE@BRANCH-AWARE-SECTOR-A-SYNTHESIS. This is a synthesis and termination audit, not a new theorem and not a parameter-identical chain. The full-production branch uses shell mass squared 0.260000000009475, while the scalar perturbative anchor uses 0.005; A4 audits both admissible positive masses without equating them. The scalar constructive result does not cover the three-component derivative Class-II functional. Operator confirmation and a PUBLISHED bundle remain open.
